title: What Environment Invariance Identifies: Minimal Invariant Sets in Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.30609v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Invariant causal prediction identifies the direct causes of a target $Y$ by searching for covariate sets whose conditional law of $Y$ is stable across environments. We state that criterion at the level of operators, calling a set $S$ invariant when the conditional mean embeddings of $Y$ given $X_S$ agree across environments, and characterise the resulting family exactly: under two conditions on the environments, which we state separately because they fail independently, the invariant sets are precisely those containing $PA(Y)$ and no descendant of $Y$. Two consequences follow. Invariance does not identify $PA(Y)$ uniquely, since every descendant-free superset is invariant as well; and $PA(Y)$ is the unique minimal invariant set. In finite samples, recovery requires the non-invariant sets to be separated from invariance by a margin, and the sample size splits into a screening term logarithmic in the ambient dimension and a term inherited

translated_title: 环境不变性究竟识别了什么：再生核希尔伯特空间中的极小不变集
translated_abstract: 不变因果预测通过搜索使目标变量 Y 的条件分布在各环境间保持稳定的协变量集合，来识别 Y 的直接原因。我们在算子层面表述该准则：当给定 X_S 时 Y 的条件均值嵌入在各环境间一致时，称集合 S 是不变的，并精确刻画了由此产生的集合族：在对环境的两个条件下（我们将其分开陈述，因为它们会各自独立失效），不变集合恰好是那些包含 PA(Y) 且不包含 Y 的任何后代的集合。由此得出两个结论：其一，不变性并不能唯一识别 PA(Y)，因为每一个不含 Y 后代的超集同样是不变的；其二，PA(Y) 是唯一的极小不变集。在有限样本情形下，恢复极小不变集要求非不变集合与不变性之间被一个间隔（margin）分隔开，且所需样本量分解为一个与周围维度呈对数关系的筛选项和一个继承项……
tldr: 本文将不变因果预测的不变性准则提升到再生核希尔伯特空间中条件均值嵌入的算子层面，精确证明了不变集恰好是包含 PA(Y) 且不含 Y 后代的集合，从而确立 PA(Y) 是唯一的极小不变集，并给出有限样本下恢复所需的样本量刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper lifts the invariance criterion of invariant causal prediction to the operator level via conditional mean embeddings in RKHS, proving that invariant sets are exactly those containing PA(Y) with no descendants of Y, hence PA(Y) is the unique minimal invariant set, with finite-sample guarantees.
